full_text: The Maharashtra Local Fund Audit Act. Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: Finance Department Type: STATE Location: Maharashtra TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles The Maharashtra Local Fund Audit Act. Show all section Section 1. Short title. Section 2. Extent. Section 3. Definitions. Section 4. Liability of local authorities to submit their accounts for audit. Section 5. Accounts to be submitted for audit at such period or periods as may be required. Section 6. Power of auditor to require production of documents and attendance of persons concerned, etc. Section 7. Penalty for disobeying requisition under section 6. Section 8. Audit report to be sent to certain officers and bodies as state Government may direct. Section 9. Audit report what to contain. Section 10. Local authority to remedy defects; Procedure to be followed after report of the Director under section 8. Section 11. Commissioner to surcharge or charge illegal payment or loss caused by gross negligence or misconduct. Section 12. Recovery of surcharges and charges how made. Section 13. Application against order of surcharge or charge. Section 14. Expenses in respect of requisition of auditors to be payable out of local fund. Section 15. Rules. Section 16. Amendments in Bom. III of 1901, Bom. VI of 1923 and Bom. XVIII of 1925. (Not printed.) Section 17. Repeal of C. P. and Berar IX of 1933 and saving. Section 18. Provisions of this Act to apply in addition to any other law relating to audit of accounts of local authorities.
